text: tlapm 310 has a second route the first refusal missed, found by testing the pinned tlapm directly: a hash collision needs no temporal operator. A hidden definition primed is abstracted to a backend atom named by 20 bits of a hash tlapm never checks, so two definitions whose primed prints collide are one symbol to SMT, Zenon or Isabelle, and a false lemma relating them proves. The pinned tlapm proves such a false theorem. The gate now also refuses a proof when any two definition names, from the proof or the ratified model it extends, would abstract to the same atom at any level, a cheap deterministic check over the names in play; this closes the non-temporal route of 310 alongside the PTL and LS4 refusal for its temporal one.
